CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION swl_private.v57_check_participation(match_id uuid, own_team uuid, candidates uuid[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  conflict_game uuid;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(cardinality(candidates),0)=0 THEN RETURN; END IF;
  WITH memberships AS (
    SELECT l.game_id,l.team_id,p.player_id
      FROM public.swl_game_lineups l
      JOIN public.swl_live_games g ON g.id=l.game_id
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL swl_private.v57_lineup_players(l) p
      WHERE g.id=match_id OR g.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','FINAL')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT v.game_id,v.team_id,v.player_id
      FROM swl_private.v57_participation v JOIN public.swl_live_games g ON g.id=v.game_id
      WHERE g.id=match_id OR g.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','FINAL')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.game_id,e.batting_team_id,ids.v::uuid
      FROM public.swl_game_events e JOIN public.swl_live_games g ON g.id=e.game_id
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (e.event_data->>'outgoing_player_id'),
                                 (e.event_data->>'incoming_player_id')) ids(v)
      WHERE (g.id=match_id OR g.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','FINAL'))
        AND e.event_type='SUBSTITUTION'
        AND ids.v ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT h.game_id,h.team_id,ids.v
      FROM public.swl_v56_pitcher_changes h JOIN public.swl_live_games g ON g.id=h.game_id
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (h.old_pitcher_id),(h.new_pitcher_id)) ids(v)
      WHERE g.id=match_id OR g.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','FINAL')
  )
  SELECT m.game_id INTO conflict_game
  FROM memberships m
  WHERE m.player_id=ANY(candidates)
    AND (m.game_id<>match_id OR m.team_id<>own_team)
  ORDER BY (m.game_id=match_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF FOUND THEN
    IF conflict_game=match_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PELOTERO_EN_AMBOS_EQUIPOS'; END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PELOTERO_EN_OTRO_PARTIDO_O_EQUIPO';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER swl_v56_sync_runner_identity_trigger AFTER UPDATE OF version ON public.swl_live_games FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION swl_v56_sync_runner_identity_version()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.swl_v56_sync_runner_identity_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.version THEN
   IF NEW.bases_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.bases_state
      OR NEW.is_top IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_top
      OR NEW.inning IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.inning THEN
      DELETE FROM public.swl_v56_runner_identity WHERE game_id=NEW.id;
   ELSE
      UPDATE public.swl_v56_runner_identity SET game_version=NEW.version WHERE game_id=NEW.id;
   END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER swl_v57_guard_participation_start BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.swl_live_games FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'::text) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status))) EXECUTE FUNCTION swl_private.v57_guard_start()
